bifrost: springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs (mgmt socket, system layer only); springboard/src/shell/pages.rs (bluetooth_spec); springboard/src/shell/control_center.rs (toggle_bluetooth); springboard/src/media/route.rs (bluetooth_sink)
summary: Core Bluetooth is the app-facing API for BLE central and peripheral roles, GATT services and characteristics, and advertising. BifrOSt drives the Bluetooth controller in the system layer (power, discovery over BR/EDR and LE, pairing, connect, disconnect, bonds, audio route) but exposes no SDK API to apps and has no GATT client or server code.

features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 9 tests. Wave 5 (w5-core-bluetooth, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. State exists in the shell and drives the Settings toggle; no SDK type reports it to an app. Authorization state has no counterpart.

features.apple: System pairing UI and bonding handled by Core Bluetooth; no direct pairing API for apps
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/bluetooth_service.rs (pair and forget requests); springboard/sdk/src/bluetooth_devices.rs (DeviceList::forget, paired devices); springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs:466 (Cmd::Pair), springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs:487 (Cmd::Forget), springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs:290-295 (bluetooth.ini stores bond keys, pin length and audio flag)
features.note: Apps send pair and forget requests to the shell and keep their own paired list, both tested inline in the SDK modules. Bonds persist across reboots in bluetooth.ini and stay in the shell. Gap: apps cannot read bond keys or require encryption on their own attributes, and the pairing prompts are the shell's.

features.note: The list model is tested headless in bluetooth_devices and parity_sdk-complete-21.rs: paired and found sections, connected devices first, names ignoring case, one row per address, and the link state labels. Gap: the Settings page does not build its rows from the model yet, and no app can reuse it; the device rows need the lab machine.

features.apple: Not part of Core Bluetooth; the system routes audio through AVAudioSession and AVRouting
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/audio_devices.rs (Change::Route and the output device); springboard/src/media/route.rs:37 (bluetooth_sink), springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs:251 (Status::audio_sink)
features.note: Apps read the output route and the default output device through the audio devices client, and a Bluetooth sink appears as one of those devices. The Bluetooth module does not carry audio: A2DP and SBC sit outside it, and audio profiles belong to the audio daemon.

features.apple: NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription and the Bluetooth permission prompt
features.note: Apple's privacy key and prompt model. The equivalent on BifrOSt would be a permission grant, which does not exist for Bluetooth. Revisit if an app API is added.

gaps: No app-facing SDK module for BLE central or peripheral roles (no CBCentralManager or CBPeripheralManager equivalent in springboard/sdk/src).
No GATT client: service and characteristic discovery, read, write and notify, plus descriptors.
No GATT server: advertising services and answering ATT requests.
No advertisement data beyond name, RSSI and the audio flag, and no service-UUID filter on scans.
No typed CBUUID, CBError or ATT error values reach apps; errors are only Settings text.
No Bluetooth background policy for apps and no permission grant for Bluetooth access.
docs/bifrost-ui.md has no Bluetooth or Core Bluetooth section, and no services doc lists a Bluetooth service (docs/services.md does not exist).
